name: Lyo.Lock
tagline: Exclusive locks by key and keyed semaphores (bounded concurrency per key), plus in-memory implementations for a single process.
description: Exclusive locks by key and keyed semaphores (bounded concurrency per key), plus in-memory implementations for a single process.
features: **ILockService.** Acquire/release by string key, or `ExecuteWithLockAsync` helpers that throw `TimeoutException` if the lock is not obtained.
**LocalLockService.** `SemaphoreSlim` gives one holder per normalized key.
**IKeyedSemaphoreService.** Up to `maxConcurrency` simultaneous permit holders per key.
**LocalKeyedSemaphoreService.** Per-key `SemaphoreSlim` with ref-counted cleanup when idle.
**Key normalization.** By default keys are compared case-insensitively (`ToLowerInvariant`). Set skip when keys are already normalized.
**Metrics.** Optional timers/counters via `Lyo.Metrics` when `EnableMetrics` is true and `IMetrics` is registered.

sections.title: Which one to pick
rows: Guard mutations to one aggregate, avoid duplicate work, serialize handlers per entity ID
Cap concurrent exports/API calls/backfills *per tenant or resource key* without global rate limits
sections.trail: More than one server or process needs a distributed `ILockService` (see [`Lyo.Lock.Redis`](../Lyo.Lock.Redis/README.md)). Keyed semaphores in this package stay process-local.

sections.title: Keyed-semaphore rules
items: Keep `maxConcurrency` stable for a given key while any permit is held or waiters exist. If you pass a different `maxConcurrency` for an active key, `LocalKeyedSemaphoreService` throws `InvalidOperationException` instead of undefined behavior.
Cancellation tokens on `ExecuteAsync` / `AcquireAsync` are honored while waiting.

sections.title: `LockOptions` (`LockOptions` section)
rows: Used by distributed locks (Redis TTL). Ignored by `LocalLockService`.
Prefix for Redis keys; harmless for local-only usage.
When `true`, keys are not lowercased (caller must ensure consistent casing).
Record lock timings/counters when `IMetrics` is available.

sections.title: `KeyedSemaphoreOptions` (section `KeyedSemaphoreOptions`)
rows: Record semaphore timings/counters when `IMetrics` is available.

sections.title: Metrics (`Constants`)
sections.lead:
With metrics on and `IMetrics` in the container, names follow `Lyo.Lock.Constants`:

**Locks (`Constants.Metrics`)**
sections.trail:
**Semaphores (`Constants.SemaphoreMetrics`)**

| Name | Role |
|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| `semaphore.acquire.duration` | Wait time for a permit |
| `semaphore.acquire.success` / `semaphore.acquire.failure` | Counter |
| `semaphore.release.duration` | Release timing |
| `semaphore.execute.duration` | Wall time for `ExecuteAsync` |

The `key` tag is the logical key string the caller passed (XML docs on `Constants` describe it).

sections.title: Methods on ILockService
items: **ExecuteWithLockAsync / ExecuteWithLockAsync<T>.** Acquire, run the delegate, release. Throw `TimeoutException` if not acquired.

sections.title: Methods on ILockHandle / IPermitHandle
items: **Dispose / DisposeAsync.** Release. Sync dispose may block briefly on the internal `ReleaseAsync`.
